description: Look into a file step by step; returns JSON. JSON file: pointer (e.g. /states/think; empty = whole file) shows one level: small values directly, big ones as children with type and size; append a key to the pointer and call again. Text file: small = whole; big = an outline first (Python class/def, Markdown headings, with line numbers), then start and end show a range. Errors: FileMissing, PointerMissing.

path.description: path relative to your workspace, or absolute

start.description: first line (text; the first line is 1)
